FN-6HSW133-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 105
Committee: Public Safety and Homeland Sponsor: Representative Chad Robertson
Security
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 02/10/2025
House Bill 105 as introduced could increase the obligations of certain local law enforcement
agencies by an estimated $1,000 for each law enforcement officer that retires and is given their
service weapon and badge as part of their retirement benefits, who would not otherwise receive
their badge and pistol at retirement. .
This bill would have an estimated aggregate fiscal impact greater than $50,000 annually on
affected local government entities and is subject to the provisions of Section 111.05 of the
Constitution of Alabama of 2022.

FN-6HSW133-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 105
Committee: Public Safety and Homeland Sponsor: Representative Chad Robertson
Security
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 02/27/2025
House Bill 105 as reported by the Committee on Public Safety and Homeland Security could
increase the obligations of certain local law enforcement agencies by: (1) an undetermined
amount dependent on the cost to provide a retiring law enforcement officer their badge as part of
their retirement benefits, who would not otherwise receive their badge at retirement; and (2) an
estimated $1,000 to allow the agency to provide a retiring law enforcement officer their
agency-issued pistol as part of their retirement benefits, who would not otherwise receive their
pistol at retirement. This bill would also increase receipts of certain law enforcement agencies
by an undetermined amount depending on the fair market value of the pistol sold to the retiring
officer.
